title: Requirements Manifest
description: Tracks which requirement versions are implemented in an app, per implementation. Dates use the timezone configured in .instructions/config.yaml → variables.timezone.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of this manifest file.

requirement_set_id.description: Canonical requirement set identifier from config.yaml → identity.requirement_set_id.

implementation_id.description: Implementation identifier. Must match a key under config.yaml → implementations.

iteration_id.description: Monotonically increasing iteration counter. Increment before each diff/plan/execute cycle.

requirements_version_target.description: Semver of the requirement set version that this iteration targets.

requirements_version_implemented.description: Semver of the requirement set version last fully implemented and verified.

requirement_baseline.description: One entry per requirement tracked in this implementation.

pinned_version.description: Semver of the requirement version implemented.

implementation_initial_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime (with timezone offset) when this requirement was first implemented. Timezone from config.yaml → variables.timezone.

implementation_last_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime (with timezone offset) when this requirement was last updated/re-implemented. Timezone from config.yaml → variables.timezone.

e2e_test_status.description: End-to-end test status for this requirement in the current iteration.
